title: Claude Code v2.1.316 Now Defaults to Haiku 5.5 Model
summary: Anthropic's Claude Code v2.1.316 now uses Haiku 5.5 as the default model for Claude Pro users, replacing previous default configurations.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Claude Code v2.1.316 officially launched on November 1, 2026 with Haiku 5.5 as the new default model for Claude Pro users.
- The update affects the model selection dropdown, now recommending Haiku 5.5 over previous defaults for coding workflows.
- Users can still manually switch between models using the /model command in the Claude Code interface.


Anthropic has updated[Claude Code](https://emergent.sh/learn/claude-code-review) to version 2.1.316, changing the default model selection to[Haiku 5.5](https://emergent.sh/learn/what-is-claude-haiku-5-5) for Claude Pro subscribers. The update, officially launched on November 1, 2026, marks a significant shift in the recommended configuration for developers using the AI-powered coding assistant.


## What Changed in Version 2.1.316


The latest Claude Code release introduces Haiku 5.5 as the default recommended model in the model selection interface. When users access the /model command, they now see Haiku 5.5 listed first with a "Default (recommended)" label. This configuration applies specifically to Claude Pro tier subscriptions, giving professional developers access to the newer model architecture out of the box.


Previous versions of Claude Code used different default configurations, but Anthropic has now standardized on Haiku 5.5 for most coding workflows. The change suggests confidence in Haiku 5.5's performance characteristics for software development tasks, including code generation, debugging, and refactoring operations.


## Model Selection and User Control


Despite the new default, Claude Code maintains full flexibility in model selection. Users can invoke the /model command at any time to switch between available options, including other Claude model families like Sonnet and Opus variants. The interface clearly labels Haiku 5.5 as the recommended choice, but developers retain complete control over which model powers their coding sessions.


This approach balances Anthropic's guidance with user autonomy. Power users who prefer different models for specific tasks can configure their preferences without friction, while new users benefit from what Anthropic considers the optimal starting configuration for general coding work.


## Availability and Access


The v2.1.316 update rolled out to all Claude Pro subscribers on November 1, 2026. Users should see the new default model configuration immediately upon updating their Claude Code installation. The change does not affect free tier users or other Claude products, focusing specifically on the professional coding tool's behavior.


Anthropic has not publicly detailed the reasoning behind selecting Haiku 5.5 as the new default, but the timing suggests alignment with recent model improvements and performance optimizations specific to code-related tasks.


## What This Means for Developers


For Claude Pro developers, this update simplifies the initial setup experience by pre-selecting what Anthropic considers the most capable model for coding tasks. Teams standardizing on Claude Code can now expect consistent out-of-the-box behavior across installations, reducing configuration overhead. The continued ability to switch models preserves workflow flexibility for specialized use cases where alternative architectures may perform better.
